changelog:
[COLOR fffdb515]Accounts stay linked[/COLOR]
-Fixed: Premiumize (reported on CoreELEC) and Trakt could say the device was approved and still not keep the account. The sign-in is now saved as soon as it arrives and your account details are filled in afterwards, so a slow or odd answer no longer loses it. Premiumize also keeps waiting through a network hiccup and writes what happened to kodi.log, never the key itself.
-Every account (Premiumize, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, TorBox, Offcloud, Trakt, SIMKL, MDBList, PunchPlay, WeTrakr and TVmaze): approving on your phone and closing the sign-in window right away no longer counts as cancelled; luc_kodi checks one last time and keeps the account.
-Setup wizards with a page on your phone (Gemini, OMDb, Custom scrapers, Newznab and the others): pressing Save on the phone and Back on the TV at almost the same time no longer loses what you filled in.
-A new account shows as linked straight away, also while Settings are still open (Kodi writes them only when that window closes). MDBList and WeTrakr no longer stop when the account details come back in an unexpected shape.
[COLOR fffdb515]Trakt lists open at once after linking[/COLOR]
-Fixed: right after linking Trakt, its lists could spin for minutes. Linking also checked about 1200 public lists, eight requests at a time, which used up what Trakt allows in 5 minutes, and that sign-in kept running until Kodi was closed.
-The Popular and Trending public lists (they only keep show lists out of Movies and film lists out of TV Shows) are now checked by the background service when they are due: one request at a time, at most 2 a second, only new or changed lists, often with one request instead of two. Force Trakt Sync and unlinking no longer wipe them.
-When Trakt asks luc_kodi to slow down, a list you open waits at most 15 seconds, once; for longer you see "Trakt is busy, try again in N seconds" instead of a list stuck loading, and background work stops and picks up later.
-Fixed: on a first Trakt link the local Trakt data was not fully cleared ("no such table: service" in the log); clearing it is also quicker.
-Your watched titles, your Trakt watchlist and "Not interested" stay out, and the Kids & Family filter uses Trakt's genres and age ratings. When Trakt has nothing for you, For You shows Trakt Trending with the same filters.
-Fixed: your taste profile never had genres, so the "Do you like it" reasons and the genre weighting did nothing; and For You no longer logs an error for every title.
